version: '1'
kind: miner
id: 0
slug: zk-truth-hashprice-canonical
protocol: generic
name: Bitcoin canonical gross block hashprice
description: Free evaluation reference for exact Bitcoin mainnet block_height. Returns
  gross expected sats per PH/s per day with six-decimal rounding, canonical block
  identity and coinbase inclusion proof. Uses public consensus facts through Allnodes
  PublicNode. No USD or daily mean.
base_url: https://telegraph-s2-hashprice.margyn.workers.dev/truth/v1
auth:
  type: none
cache_ttl_sec: 0
rate_limit_per_sec: 1
errors:
  message_path: error.message
  code_path: error.code
endpoints:
- path: /hashprice
  external_path: /hashprice
  method: GET
  description: Supply exact block_height as one integer query parameter. The response
    directly contains hashprice_sats_per_ph_day in sats per PH/s per day. Verification
    failure returns non-200 with no scored value.
  intents:
  - MINING_HASHPRICE_VERIFY_GENERAL
  params:
    query:
      required:
      - name: block_height
        type: integer
        intents:
        - MINING_HASHPRICE_VERIFY_GENERAL
        description: Exact Bitcoin mainnet height from 0 to 100000000. Plain decimal
          digits. Never replace with a block hash, latest height or timestamp.
input_schema:
  type: object
  required:
  - block_height
  additionalProperties: false
  properties:
    block_height:
      type: integer
      minimum: 0
      maximum: 100000000
output_schema:
  type: object
  required:
  - hashprice_sats_per_ph_day
  - block_height
  properties:
    hashprice_sats_per_ph_day:
      type: number
      minimum: 1
      maximum: 1000000000
    block_height:
      type: integer
intent_mapping:
  MINING_HASHPRICE_VERIFY_GENERAL:
    endpoint: /hashprice
    input:
      block_height:
        from: block_height
        how: Preserve the exact requested integer Bitcoin mainnet height.
    output:
      hashprice_sats_per_ph_day:
        path: hashprice_sats_per_ph_day
        unit: sats per PH/s per day
      block_height:
        path: block_height
      hashrate_eh_s:
        path: hashrate_eh_s
        unit: EH/s
      hashprice_usd_per_ph_day:
        path: hashprice_usd_per_ph_day
        unit: USD per PH/s per day
semantics:
  supported_intents:
  - MINING_HASHPRICE_VERIFY_GENERAL
